full_judgment: 2. The case arose on the basis of FIR lodged by opposite party No.2, Area Manager (Seeds) BADC Cantonment Road, Ambagan, Rajshahi with an allegation that while he was walking in his office room about 4 PM on 21-3-87, accused persons entered into his room and assaulted him and abused him with filthy language. After assaulting him, the accused went upstairs in the room of the Divisional Manager, BADC and also assaulted him. After investigation, charge-sheet under sections 143/448/323 of the Penal Code was submitted against the accused persons and before commencement of trial, charge was also framed against them under those sections. The prosecution examined 7 witnesses including the informant and investigation officer and the defence examined 2 witnesses. The defence case is that no occurrence at all took place as alleged by the prosecution. The learned Magistrate on the ground of some discrimination in statement of the PWs and relying on the statement of the DWs came to the finding that the prosecution could not prove the charge beyond any reasonable doubt and with that finding acquitted all the accused.
